const.alpha.note: raw significance threshold used only for counting

const.ci_pct.note: nominal coverage of every interval in the report

coverage.events_post.note: metal sampling events from 2015-10-01, all organisations

coverage.events_pre.note: metal sampling events 2005-01-01 to 2015-08-04, all organisations

coverage.r4.events_per_year_post2y.note: same, 2015-10-01 to 2017-09-30 (the two years after the plant start)

coverage.r4.events_per_year_pre.note: metal sampling events per year at the four River Watch reaches, 2005-01-01 to 2015-08-04

coverage.r4.orgs_pre_steady.note: organisations with at least 100 pre-period events at the four reaches

cp.explore.n_rows_removed.note: exploratory: rows below a tenth of the 5th percentile of detected values removed

cp.explore.post_release_shift_pct.note: percent shift in level across the first change-point at or after the release

cp.headline.first_shift_pct.note: percent change in the flow-adjusted level across the first PELT change-point

cp.headline.pelt_rel_release_months.note: months after (+) or before (-) 2015-08 for each PELT change-point

cq.headline.resid_mean_post.note: raw post-period mean residual, before the ITS; descriptive only

cq.headline.slope.note: d ln C / d ln Q, pre-period

did.control_zinc.level_change_pct.note: the upstream control's own ITS level change, dissolved zinc

did.headline.n_pairs.note: months with an uncensored residual at both Cement Creek and the control

explore.clean.grid.median_sigma_ratio.note: median ratio of the residual scale after to before removing implausible rows

explore.flow.n_pairs.note: samples with an instantaneous discharge and a daily mean on the same day

its.headline.change_at_end_pct.note: level change plus slope change accumulated to the end of the post-period, point estimate only

its.headline.verdict.note: pre-registered rule 1-3 applied to the primary fit and the three pre-period starts

mult.n_bh_sig.note: Benjamini-Hochberg at 5% FDR among estimable cells

mult.n_negative_point.note: estimable cells with a negative point estimate

prepare.excl.E01_media.note: ActivityMediaName must be Water (sediment, soil, tissue, pore water out)

prepare.excl.E03_qc.note: Quality-control activities go to qc_samples.csv, not the sample table

prepare.excl.E04_activity_type.note: ActivityTypeCode must be a routine sample or field measurement

prepare.excl.E05_flow.note: Instantaneous discharge rows go to sample_flow.csv

prepare.excl.E06_fraction.note: Metal rows need a dissolved or total/recoverable fraction label

prepare.excl.E08_unit.note: Result (or limit, for non-detects) unit must convert to the canonical unit

prepare.excl.E09_value.note: A detected row needs a numeric value; a non-detect needs a numeric limit

prepare.excl.E10_positive.note: Metals and conductance must be > 0 (log scale)

prepare.excl.E11_duplicates.note: One result per org/site/date/time/constituent/fraction: keep the first ResultIdentifier

snapshot.wqx3_rows.note: same query on the WQX3 fullPhysChem profile; equals the STORET count, i.e. no NWIS rows

tests.n_tests.note: count of `def test_` functions in tests/
